reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper forecast, schedules/app, budget templates and the UI use.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the expected-amount rule stays in its single shared definition.

placement.why: The field is added in the API model mapping (scheduleModel.toExternal) and typed via a list-specific API type in api-handlers, matching how the API layer is organised.

scope.why: Only the mapping, its types, updated API test expectations and a release note.

maintainability.why: A one-line call to the shared rule plus an explicit list type keeps the API output in sync with any future rule change.
